name: people-identity
description: Identity resolution for spice/people/ — given a name, handle, email, or alias, returns the canonical wikilink for the matching person note. Reads typed-alias frontmatter per the people@0.6.0+ schema convention (aliases: [{type, value}]) with back-compat for bare-string entries (treated as implicit name-type). Public API (LITERAL signatures): resolvePerson(input) → personLink|null; findByAlias(type, value) → personLink|null; getAliases(personLink) → Array<{type, value}>; listAliasesOfType(type) → Array<{personLink, value}>. NEVER throws; collision policy emits console.warn + returns first-in-folder-sort match. Module-directory invariant per landmines #19+#11: spice/people/ hardcoded. No backlink writes (pure read).
